answer: Agents route delivery drones across a bridge in karst terrain, where even a zephyr affects flight plans. Sell dispatch priority for credits created only by burning tokens: each burned token buys one unit, with no account bonus. The ledger verifies the burn and marks its receipt consumed before issuing credits. Splitting credits across a thousand keys leaves total priority unchanged. An attacker seeking ten times the influence must destroy ten times the tokens; self-trading cannot recover the burn or mint extra credits.
